name: greetings-as-people-join
description: Hellos while people join: greeting someone who just joined isn't evidence about who spoke before.
lines: Hi Sam, can you hear me okay?
Yes, loud and clear. Hi Priya.
Great. Hi Siobhan, you've just joined.
Morning both, sorry I'm late, the last meeting overran.
No worries. Okay, let's get started with the roadmap.
